result.summary: Found 2 issues: a broken discount badge showing '-0%' and a minor truncated card in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The pizza card (partially visible 'Popular right now' item) displays a discount badge reading '-0%', which is meaningless and likely a data or rendering bug (a zero or miscomputed discount).
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation so a real percentage shows (e.g. '-20%'), or hide the badge entirely when no discount applies.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with truncated text; if the carousel isn't clearly scrollable, users may miss content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel is clearly scrollable (peek hint, scroll indicators, or snap behavior) and avoid truncating restaurant names.
